cc:Work.dc:description:
import numpy as np import matplotlib as mpl import matplotlib.pyplot as plt from matplotlib.patches import FancyArrowPatch, Arc, Polygon
# The final, explicitly corrected target in the prompt is x = [3, 4]^T. x = np.array([3.0, 4.0]) u0 = np.array([1.0, 1.0]) u1 = np.array([1.0, 2.0]) c0, c1 = 2.0, 1.0 if not np.allclose(c0 * u0 + c1 * u1, x): raise ValueError("The supplied coefficients and basis do not reproduce the target.")
blue = "#33658A" terra = "#C66B4E" ink = "#263238" slate = "#657786"
mpl.rcParams.update({ "font.family": "DejaVu Sans", "font.size": 10, "mathtext.fontset": "dejavusans", "text.color": ink, "axes.labelcolor": ink, "axes.edgecolor": slate, "xtick.color": slate, "ytick.color": slate, "axes.spines.top": False, "axes.spines.right": False, "figure.facecolor": "white", "axes.facecolor": "white", "svg.fonttype": "none", })
fig = plt.figure(figsize=(9.2, 4.0), dpi=100) fig.text(0.055, 0.945, "Non-orthogonal bases couple the coefficients", fontsize=16, weight="semibold", va="top")
fig.text(0.055, 0.835, "a One signal, two views", fontsize=12, weight="semibold") fig.text(0.055, 0.765, r"Target: $\mathbf{x}=[3,\;4]^{\mathsf{T}}$", fontsize=11)
fig.text(0.495, 0.835, "b Non-orthogonal decomposition", fontsize=12, weight="semibold") fig.text(0.495, 0.765, r"$\mathbf{x}=2\mathbf{u}_0+\mathbf{u}_1$", fontsize=11)
ax_stem = fig.add_axes([0.065, 0.265, 0.125, 0.415]) ax_target = fig.add_axes([0.265, 0.245, 0.185, 0.475]) ax_basis = fig.add_axes([0.495, 0.245, 0.285, 0.475]) ax_eq = fig.add_axes([0.805, 0.245, 0.18, 0.475]) ax_eq.axis("off")
# Two-sample discrete-time representation. markers, stems, baseline = ax_stem.stem([0, 1], x, basefmt=" ") plt.setp(stems, color=ink, linewidth=2) plt.setp(markers, color=ink, marker="o", markersize=5) ax_stem.set_xlim(-0.4, 1.4) ax_stem.set_ylim(0, 4.9) ax_stem.set_xticks([0, 1]) ax_stem.set_yticks([0, 2, 4]) ax_stem.set_xlabel(r"Sample $n$", labelpad=7) ax_stem.set_ylabel(r"$x[n]$", labelpad=7) ax_stem.tick_params(length=3, labelsize=9) for n, value in enumerate(x): ax_stem.text(n, value + 0.18, f"{value:g}", ha="center", fontsize=10)
def setup_plane(ax, xmax=3.7): ax.set_xlim(-0.12, xmax) ax.set_ylim(-0.12, 4.65) ax.set_aspect("equal", adjustable="box") for spine in ax.spines.values(): spine.set_visible(False) ax.set_xticks([0, 1, 2, 3]) ax.set_yticks([1, 2, 3, 4]) ax.tick_params(length=2.5, width=0.7, labelsize=9, pad=3) ax.annotate("", xy=(xmax, 0), xytext=(0, 0), arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle="-|>", color=slate, lw=0.9, mutation_scale=9)) ax.annotate("", xy=(0, 4.65), xytext=(0, 0), arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle="-|>", color=slate, lw=0.9, mutation_scale=9)) ax.set_xlabel(r"$x[0]$", labelpad=6) ax.set_ylabel(r"$x[1]$", labelpad=6)
def vector(ax, start, end, color, lw=2, linestyle="-", zorder=4): patch = FancyArrowPatch( start, end, arrowstyle="-|>", mutation_scale=12, linewidth=lw, color=color, linestyle=linestyle, shrinkA=0, shrinkB=0, zorder=zorder ) ax.add_patch(patch)
# The identical target, now in sample-coordinate space. setup_plane(ax_target) ax_target.plot([3, 3], [0, 4], color=slate, lw=0.9, ls=(0, (3, 3)), alpha=0.5) ax_target.plot([0, 3], [4, 4], color=slate, lw=0.9, ls=(0, (3, 3)), alpha=0.5) vector(ax_target, (0, 0), x, ink, lw=2.2) ax_target.text(2.65, 4.25, r"$\mathbf{x}$", fontsize=12) ax_target.set_title("Sample-coordinate plane", fontsize=9, color=slate, pad=5)
# Parallelogram: vertices 0, 2u0, x, u1. setup_plane(ax_basis, xmax=3.9) ax_basis.add_patch(Polygon( [(0, 0), tuple(2 * u0), tuple(x), tuple(u1)], closed=True, facecolor=blue, alpha=0.045, edgecolor="none", zorder=0 )) vector(ax_basis, 2 * u0, x, terra, lw=1.5, linestyle=(0, (4, 3)), zorder=2) vector(ax_basis, u1, x, blue, lw=1.5, linestyle=(0, (4, 3)), zorder=2) vector(ax_basis, (0, 0), 2 * u0, blue, lw=2.2) vector(ax_basis, (0, 0), u0, blue, lw=2.2, zorder=5) vector(ax_basis, (0, 0), u1, terra, lw=2.2) vector(ax_basis, (0, 0), x, ink, lw=2.2, zorder=6)
ax_basis.text(1.12, 0.65, r"$\mathbf{u}_0$", color=blue, fontsize=11) ax_basis.text(2.13, 1.73, r"$2\mathbf{u}_0$", color=blue, fontsize=11) ax_basis.text(0.58, 2.25, r"$\mathbf{u}_1$", color=terra, fontsize=11) ax_basis.text(3.12, 4.04, r"$\mathbf{x}$", color=ink, fontsize=12)
angle0 = np.degrees(np.arctan2(u0[1], u0[0])) angle1 = np.degrees(np.arctan2(u1[1], u1[0])) theta = angle1 - angle0 ax_basis.add_patch(Arc((0, 0), 1.35, 1.35, theta1=angle0, theta2=angle1, color=slate, lw=1.2, zorder=7)) ax_basis.text(0.13, 0.83, r"$\theta$", color=slate, fontsize=10)
# The equations use the same sample coordinates as both plotted views. ax_eq.text(0, 1.0, "Coupled equations", fontsize=11, weight="semibold", va="top") ax_eq.text(0, 0.79, r"$c_0+c_1=3$", fontsize=13, va="top") ax_eq.text(0, 0.61, r"$c_0+2c_1=4$", fontsize=13, va="top") ax_eq.text(0, 0.38, r"$c_0=2,\quad c_1=1$", fontsize=11, va="top") ax_eq.text(0, 0.14, r"$\mathbf{u}_0^{\mathsf{T}}\mathbf{u}_1=3\ne 0$", fontsize=10, va="top") ax_eq.text(0, -0.045, rf"$\theta={theta:.1f}^\circ\ne 90^\circ$", fontsize=10, color=slate, va="top")
fig.text(0.055, 0.12, "The same two samples define one vector.", fontsize=10, color=slate) fig.text(0.495, 0.12, "Each sample depends on both coefficients.", fontsize=10, color=ink) fig.text(0.055, 0.045, "Signal amplitudes are dimensionless.", fontsize=9, color=slate) fig.text(0.495, 0.045, r"Basis: $\mathbf{u}_0=[1,1]^{\mathsf{T}}$ (constant);" r" $\mathbf{u}_1=[1,2]^{\mathsf{T}}$ (rising ramp).", fontsize=9, color=slate)
